title: Liquid Web Review 2026: Managed WordPress, Nexcess, Speed Tests and Pricing
excerpt: Liquid Web now runs Nexcess. Managed WordPress starts at $19 a month, handled 1,000 users without errors, and has no Asian data center. Here is who it suits.

meta._yoast_wpseo_title: Liquid Web Review 2026: Managed WordPress, Pricing, Speed
meta._yoast_wpseo_metadesc: Liquid Web review for 2026: managed WordPress prices, the Nexcess merger, speed and load tests from five independent reports, WooCommerce, pros and cons.
meta.rl_answer: Liquid Web, which now includes Nexcess, is fast managed WordPress and WooCommerce hosting from $19 a month. Two tests saw 0% errors at 1,000 concurrent users, and there are no data centers in Asia.
meta.rl_faqs:
Is Liquid Web good? | Yes for business sites and stores in the US, UK and Australia. Two tests saw 0% errors at 1,000 concurrent users.
Is Nexcess the same as Liquid Web? | Yes. TechRadar said Nexcess is now fully absorbed into Liquid Web, and managed WordPress runs on the Nexcess cloud.
How much does Liquid Web managed WordPress cost? | Pro WordPress starts at $19 a month for 50,000 visits. Elite starts at $29 a month. Annual billing saves 10%.
How fast is Liquid Web? | Webhostingcat measured a 202 ms time to first byte and a 433 ms Largest Contentful Paint.
Is Liquid Web good for WooCommerce? | Yes for light to medium stores. Webhostingcat saw a slow checkout in its test, so test yours.
Does Liquid Web have data centers in Asia? | No. Sayan Samanta measured up to 1.9 seconds to first byte from India.
Does Liquid Web have a money-back guarantee? | The managed WordPress page we read did not show one. Check the live terms.
Does Liquid Web include backups and staging? | Yes. Daily backups are kept 14 days on Pro and 30 days on Elite, with a staging and dev site listed.
Does Liquid Web offer free migration? | Liquid Web lists human-assisted migration. Reviewers describe it as free.
Does Liquid Web have AI features? | The page we read did not list any.
Is Liquid Web better than Kinsta? | Liquid Web costs less at entry. Kinsta lists a money-back guarantee and published speed results in more tests.
Who should avoid Liquid Web? | Owners with mostly Asian visitors, beginners who want a simple host and people who need a stated money-back guarantee.

meta.rl_takeaways:
Two tests saw 0% errors at 1,000 concurrent users.
Webhostingcat measured a 202 ms time to first byte and a 433 ms LCP.
Liquid Web has no data centers in Asia, and first-byte times reached 1.9 seconds from India.
Pro WordPress starts at $19 a month, and Nexcess is now Liquid Web.
meta.rl_r_verdict: Liquid Web is a fast, human-supported managed WordPress and WooCommerce host for US, UK and Australian audiences. Servers took 1,000 concurrent users without errors in two tests. Check checkout speed on your own store, and look elsewhere for Asian visitors.
meta.rl_r_buy:
You run a business, agency or WooCommerce site with US, UK or Australian visitors.
You want managed care, daily backups and human support.
You expect traffic spikes.
meta.rl_r_skip:
Most of your visitors are in Asia.
You want a simple shared host as a beginner.
You need a money-back guarantee stated on the page.
meta.rl_r_pros:
Pages load in well under a second in several tests.
0% errors at 1,000 concurrent users in two tests.
Daily backups, staging and Object Cache Pro.
Human support with fast replies.
Free human-assisted migration listed.
meta.rl_r_cons:
No data centers in Asia.
WooCommerce checkout was slow in one test.
No money-back guarantee on the page we read.
Prices rise with visit tiers.
Cloudflare setup problems in one reviewer's test.
meta.rl_r_best: Business sites and stores with US, UK or Australian visitors
meta.rl_r_method:
Our own use | We do not host our websites with Liquid Web, so this review rests on published data. Each test is credited to its publisher
Pricing and terms | Liquid Web's managed WordPress page and Black Friday page, read on 15 and 16 November 2026. The Black Friday page body still showed 2025 dates, so we treat the sale as unconfirmed
Independent tests | Webhostingcat (23 April 2026), Sayan Samanta (3 months on WooCommerce), SimonHosting (4 GB VPS), Cloudzat and Website Planet, each with method and date
Competitor reviews | The top-ranking Liquid Web and Nexcess reviews read
When sources disagree | We show both views. For prices we use Liquid Web's own page
Freshness | Prices and offers are read again before this page goes live
What we did not do | We did not run our own speed or uptime test
